verdict.rationale: Finix documents managing how sellers get paid out via the Dashboard or API. It also mentions setting payout schedules and offers real-time payouts to bank accounts or cards. However, the evidence never lists the specific cadences (daily, weekly, monthly, manual) or shows instant payout being configured per seller. missing for 10: an explicit list of daily/weekly/monthly/manual schedule options, documented per-seller schedule configuration, the instant/real-time option tied to seller settlement, and independent corroboration.

support.subject: As an ops user, payouts run on the schedule each seller needs — daily, weekly, monthly, or manual, plus instant payouts to cards or real-time rails where supported, configurable per seller

citations.quote: You can manage how sellers get paid out using the Finix Dashboard or our API.
Use Payouts to send funds directly to a recipient's bank account or card in real-time.
Make a payout to a recipient's credit or debit card.
